# ISV Knowledge Base

> Volunteer IEEE Smart Village Technology Committee knowledge base — metering interoperability, meeting notes, technical reports, and open AMI/MQTT profiles. Not an official IEEE website; program site: https://smartvillage.ieee.org/

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://isv.wiki/AGENTS.md): Navigation guide for AI assistants — trust hierarchy, file map, contributor rules
- [auth.md](https://isv.wiki/auth.md): Public site — no OAuth / no agent registration on this host
- [Overview](https://isv.wiki/index.html#village-metering/overview): Village Metering section entry — why ISV, gateway path, hardware threads
- [Roadmap](https://isv.wiki/index.html#village-metering/roadmap): Three-phase development plan — installed-base interop, microgrid core, grid connectivity (ThunderCloud Phase 1 note)
- [Village scope](https://isv.wiki/index.html#village-metering/village-scope): ISV operational village definition, global rural population, energy access, HDI, healthy vs unhealthy modernization (cited)
- [Problems to solve](https://isv.wiki/index.html#village-metering/problems): Field metering problems for village mini-grids
- [Solutions map](https://isv.wiki/index.html#village-metering/solutions-map): Interactive diagram linking problems to ISV-tracked approaches
- [Meter vendor study](https://isv.wiki/meter-vendor-study.html): Cited vendor benchmark for village mini-grid metering
- [Village GeoJSON · Map Twin](https://isv.wiki/meter-village-geojson-un.html): Essential vs nice-to-have open Utility Network–style layers
- [VMRS registers](https://isv.wiki/meter-benchmark/vmrs-registers.json): Draft Village Minimum Register Set (OBIS shortlist)
- [Northbound MQTT v0.1](https://isv.wiki/meter-benchmark/northbound-mqtt-v0.1.json): OpenAMI village meter northbound JSON/MQTT profile
- [Technical reports catalog](https://isv.wiki/technical-notes/catalog.json): Report index with provenance (Dev Labs, ISV wiki, external)
- [Power Africa 2026 Workshop](https://isv.wiki/power-africa-2026-workshop-planning.html): OpenAMI EMS workshop planning (Nairobi · EAT · UTC+3)
- [MeshEMS v2.0](https://isv.wiki/index.html#village-metering/meshems): MeshEMS v2.0 pole controller, BOM, schematic
- [Village Simulator](https://isv.wiki/index.html#village-metering/village-simulator): Hypothetical 3D prepaid village microgrid simulation hub
- [Standards guide](https://isv.wiki/index.html#standards): Standards catalog (village-relevant vs larger grid)
- [Wiki home](https://isv.wiki/): Human UI shell — prefer direct file URLs above for agents

## Discovery (well-known)

- [ARD ai-catalog](https://isv.wiki/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Capability manifest (docs, JSON specs, skills)
- [Agent Skills index](https://isv.wiki/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): navigate-isv-wiki · cite-evidence · village-map-twin
- [API catalog](https://isv.wiki/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset
- [Agent index (DNS-AID HTTP)](https://isv.wiki/.well-known/agents/index.json): No live MCP/A2A on this host

## DNS-AID

Discovery (Cloudflare DNS, not in repo): `_index._agents.isv.wiki` HTTPS → `isv.wiki` with DNSSEC. Setup: `technical-notes/AGENT-READINESS-CLOUDFLARE.md`.

## Optional

- [GitHub source](https://github.com/overview-solutions/isv-ai-wiki): MIT-licensed repo; push to `main` deploys the site
- Cloudflare **Markdown for Agents** (Accept: text/markdown) is a zone dashboard toggle — see AGENT-READINESS-CLOUDFLARE.md
